name: Wongduean
text:
the tills are short a float roll again cuz we used the last one on the pop up stall, plz grab a box from the store b4 saturday, cheers,
Wongduean

name: Reithmayer
text:
the spare projector bulb in the cupboard is the wrong fitting n the box is empty, can u order two more b4 the agm next week, the caretakers key fob still opens the side room so thats fine, thanks,
Reithmayer

name: Siriana Batjari
text:
the summer fete stall list went round the group chat n the tombola table is still without a volunteer, i can do the first hour but the second needs filling b4 friday, also the banner poles are in the loft n someone with a van needs to grab them, thanks,
Siriana Batjari

name: Charlize Johannita
text:
the upstairs printer keeps eating the labels n the spare tray is in the cupboard, can u look at it b4 the morning run, thanks,
Charlize Johannita

name: Agil
text:
the community hall front door lock is stiff again n the code pad beeps twice, the caretaker said to jiggle the handle first but thats not working every time, can u book the locksmith for monday, thanks,
Agil

name: Fornier
text:
the soft play session is fully booked for saturday n two parents have asked about a waitlist, the form is in the drawer if u want to add them, also the ball pit needs a top up from the store room n the sanitiser wipes are nearly out, plz grab both on ur way past, thanks,
Fornier

name: Margarette Florentina-Alexandra
text:
the charity run bibs came in the wrong colour n the printer jammed the roll, can u sort both b4 nine, thanks,
Margarette Florentina-Alexandra

name: Zurijeta Tovano
text:
the room hire sheet for july has two double bookings n the font got changed by accident, can u fix the grid n print a fresh copy for the noticeboard, the caretaker wants one for the file too, thanks,
Zurijeta Tovano

name: Virtudes
text:
the allotment shop rota for august is still half empty n the keyholder list is out of date, three people have moved plots since spring so the map needs redrawing, the shed inventory is done but the seed tin count is short, can u check the book n let me know what we actually sold, thanks,
Virtudes

name: Beçiri
text:
the badge printer is out of ribbon n the new starter needs a pass by ten, can u raid the drawer in reception, thanks,
Beçiri

name: Afaf Rukman
text:
the defib cabinet alarm went off at 3am n the battery pack needs swapping, i couldnt find the spare in the usual spot, can u check the supply cupboard n log it in the book, the paramedic said the pads are fine, thanks,
Afaf Rukman

name: Gohar Veksler
text:
the quiz night score sheets have gone missing from the folder n the trophy needs engraving b4 the end of the month, the pub has offered to host again but wants the date confirmed, i can ring round the usual teams if u handle the engravers, the raffle tickets are still in the box from last year, thanks,
Gohar Veksler

name: Bouhkou
text:
the works van needs its service stamp n the log book is in the glovebox, can u drop it off b4 noon, thanks,
Bouhkou

name: Crisanta
text:
The trolley run to the wards was completed before the shift change and the empty cages came back to the loading bay. Two drip stands were swapped for working ones and the broken pair was tagged for repair. Thanks,
Crisanta

name: Zarate
text:
The delivery ramp was swept and the edge strip was repainted before the morning intake. Two pallets were re-wrapped after the shrink wrap split on the way in. The paperwork was matched against the manifest and one short line was flagged to purchasing for a credit note. The forklift was charged and the bay was left clear. Thanks,
Zarate

name: Siv Auguste
text:
The mats were shaken and the wet floor sign was left by the side entrance. The mop heads went through the wash and the bucket was rinsed. Thanks,
Siv Auguste

name: Cillian Samar
text:
The meter readings were taken at both sites and the figures were logged in the portal before noon. One meter was replaced by the supplier during the week and the serial numbers were updated on the asset list. Thanks,
Cillian Samar

name: Nigina
text:
The window boxes along the front were planted up with the winter bedding and the old compost went on the border. Two brackets were replaced after the frost loosened them and the watering cans were filled ready for the dry spell. The greenhouse vents were checked and the broken pane in the side wall was taped off. Thanks,
Nigina

name: Ghazi
text:
The pool covers were rolled back for the early session and the lane ropes were checked. The timer on the showers was set to four minutes. Thanks,
Ghazi

name: Yingshan Jie
text:
The kit bags were packed for the weekend fixtures and the shirts went in after the sponsor patches were pressed on. The physio taped the two players late and the ice packs were restocked. The minibus fuel card was topped up. Thanks,
Yingshan Jie

name: Heavenly Ottiger Zarfino
text:
The kiln was loaded for the glaze firing. Three pots were set aside as they were still damp and need to go in the next batch. The vents were checked against the firing chart and the kiln sitter was tested. The whole load should come out thursday. Thanks,
Heavenly Ottiger Zarfino

name: Zohar
text:
The choir stalls were dusted and the hymn books were restacked in the correct order. The sound desk was covered for the night. Thanks,
Zohar

name: Garnica
text:
The bike racks were pressure washed and the loose bolts were tightened before the weekend. Two saddles were re-clamped after they moved and the pump was tethered back to the post. The broken u-lock left overnight was bagged and logged at the office. Thanks,
Garnica

name: Eya Lorup
text:
The archive boxes for the old ledgers were moved to the strong room and the shelf list was updated with the new locations. The reading room was vacuumed under the tables and the lamp on the far desk was replaced with a working one. The humidity gauge was checked and the reading was inside the band. Thanks,
Eya Lorup

name: Borka Liegl
text:
The sample trays were washed and stacked and the labels were reprinted for the morning run. The balance was levelled on the bench. Thanks,
Borka Liegl

name: Veksler
text:
The scoreboard was tested with the new remote and the bulbs behind the numbers were all working. The nets were checked and one post was re-set in concrete. The corner flags were counted back and the kit room was locked. Thanks,
Veksler

name: Kinfe
text: Kinfe can u check the rota for the summer fair cuz i think two stalls are down for the same slot, also the van hire needs confirming b4 the end of the week n we still havent got the gazebo pegs back from the cricket club, the prize envelopes are in the safe, ta

name: Barkate
text: Barkate the keypad code got changed again n nobody told the cleaners, can u sort it b4 eight cuz theyre stood outside

name: Utjesanovic Bakowicz Maitan
text: Utjesanovic Bakowicz Maitan the handover sheet for the night shift is blank again, ive got the crib count but not the press notes, can u chase the guys on lates to fill it in, the die change list is the part to check

name: Bolecek Göçümcü Palazzi
text: Bolecek Göçümcü Palazzi the training room laptop wont connect to the projector anymore n the hdmi socket looks loose, sessions run twice next week so it needs fixing asap, ive tried the spare cable n changed the input but no luck, can u log a ticket with it, the old clicker is in my drawer if needed

name: Tinsae
text: Tinsae the bread delivery went to the old address again, can u ring the depot b4 the rush n sort the credit

name: Rashidian
text: Rashidian the urinal in the gents is running constantly n ive put a cone outside, the plumber said hes on another job till 2 but the water bill is gonna be daft, can u chase him n get an eta

name: Ajiz Baldomero
text: Ajiz Baldomero the fridge in the back kitchen is warm n the seal looks perished, products are fine cuz we moved them to the chiller, the engineer came last month n said it was the thermostat so its probably that again, can u book him back n put a note on the door, the temp log is on the clipboard

name: Lo Priore
text: Lo Priore the gate code for the yard has stopped working n the fob box is empty again, can u reset it b4 the delivery

name: Aleeke
text: Aleeke the click n collect orders are backing up cuz the label printer keeps jamming, ive cleared it twice but the roller feels rough, can u order a new one n use the spare till it lands, the queue out front is getting silly

name: Bekri
text: Bekri the pool timetable got swapped with the school one so the lanes are double booked friday morning, the swim club is gonna kick off if we move them again, can u ring the school b4 they print the new cards, the notice on the board needs changing too n the website still shows the old times

name: Hasini Alloggia
text: Hasini Alloggia the recycling bins were missed again n the cardboard is piling up out back, can u ring the council

name: Elshadai Ita
text: Elshadai Ita the window cleaner is coming thursday but the back gate is padlocked n the code changed last week, can u leave the spare key with the office n text him the new number, also the front sills havent been cleaned

name: Kayahan
text: Kayahan checked the roof drainage run after the storm and cleared two gullies of leaves before the water could back up. He found a split in the downpipe joint and wrapped it as a temporary fix. The replacement section is on order and the wall beneath stayed dry overnight. He logged the repair and booked the follow up for monday.

name: Umukoro
text: Umukoro signed for the pallet at the gate and walked the driver through to bay four. The paperwork matched the load and the empty cages went back on the lorry.

name: Rognini Marsidi
text: Rognini Marsidi rebuilt the display for the spring campaign after the shelving collapsed overnight. She re-counted the stock against the list, moved the damaged boxes to the returns cage and re-pinned the safety notice. The window vinyl was reordered because the old one peeled.

name: Shantel Lindskog
text: Shantel Lindskog walked the new tenants through the flat before the keys changed hands and noted the meter readings on the form. She showed them where the stopcock sits and how the boiler timer works, then checked the smoke alarms while they waited. The inventory photos were taken room by room and the deposit scheme paperwork was explained.

name: Chengyi
text: Chengyi set the room up for the hearing panel and tested the loop before anyone arrived. The spare batteries went by the door. She stacked the chairs afterwards.

name: Boves
text: Boves traced the water leak to the joint under the sink and dried the cupboard out with the fan. He replaced the washer, ran the tap for five minutes and checked underneath for drips. The plinth went back and the customer was shown the valve.

name: Valdecir Prastaj
text: Valdecir Prastaj took the minibus for its inspection and waited while the brake test ran. The examiner flagged a worn wiper blade, so he swapped it from the spares box and had the certificate re-stamped. He fuelled up. The mileage and fuel figures were written on the depot sheet and the keys went back on the hook.

name: Zéna Zemira
text: Zéna Zemira checked the drip trays under the machines and emptied them into the waste drum. She wiped the guards afterwards. A fresh drum was fitted before the shift ended.

name: Ricards
text: Ricards rewired the plug on the kettle lead after it scorched and ran a test boil. He found a second lead with a cracked casing and binned it on the spot. The PAT log was updated with both repairs and the labels were re-punched.

name: Dewa
text: Dewa collected the keys for the boiler room and walked the new contractor round the plant, pointing out the isolation valves and the emergency stop. He checked the gas detector was in date and showed where the log sheet lives. The contractor signed in at the office and was given a visitor badge for the week.

name: Bagdagül Akshatha
text: Bagdagül Akshatha restocked the vending machines on both floors and cleared the coin jam in the drinks unit. She logged the shortfall and left a note for the route driver.

name: Smeele Fisher-Pollard
text: Smeele Fisher-Pollard transferred the seedling trays to the cold frame and watered the run before the heat came in. They thinned the carrots and re-labelled the herb pots. The hose was drained and coiled and the tap washer was changed while the water was off.
